segments.title: The Trillionaire Paradox & The $1 Hook
segments.summary: Establishes the extreme disparity: SpaceX goes public in 2026, Elon becomes first trillionaire. An ordinary person with $1 is closer to the 2nd richest person than that person is to Elon. Hook ends with: 'Fired from both companies he built, bet everything on rockets that kept exploding, and somehow ended up here.'

segments.title: Childhood in South Africa & Blastar
segments.summary: Born in Pretoria (1971), difficult childhood, bullying, devouring encyclopedia, teaching himself to code and selling video game Blastar for $500 at age 12. Escaping to Canada with $2,000.

segments.title: Zip2: Sleeping on the Office Floor to $22 Million
segments.summary: Dropping out of Stanford after 2 days (1995). Building Zip2 (yellow pages + internet map). Living in office, showering at YMCA. Board strips him of CEO role. Sold to Compaq for $307M, Elon pockets $22M. Buys McLaren F1.

segments.title: X.com & PayPal: Coup on a Honeymoon Flight
segments.summary: Puts $12M into X.com (online bank). Merges with Peter Thiel's Confinity. Rebranded to PayPal. Board stage a coup while Elon is on an airplane for his honeymoon and fires him. Company sold to eBay for $1.5B, Elon nets $180M.

segments.title: SpaceX & Tesla: Betting Everything (2002-2007)
segments.summary: Trips to Russia to buy ICBMs (spit on by Russian engineers). Founds SpaceX with $100M. Invests in Tesla Motors. Falcon 1 launch 1 explodes (corrosion). Launch 2 fails to reach orbit. Launch 3 collides with stage 1. Running out of money.

segments.title: Christmas 2008: 72 Hours from Complete Bankruptcy
segments.summary: Financial crisis. Both SpaceX and Tesla bleeding cash. Falcon 1 launch 4 is the last bullet: success on Sept 28, 2008! But Tesla is hours from missing payroll. Dec 23, 2008: NASA awards $1.6B contract. Dec 24 (Christmas Eve): Tesla investors close bridge loan with minutes to spare.

segments.title: The Empire Scaling: Reusability, Model 3 Hell & Valuation Surges
segments.summary: Falcon 9 landing boosters on drone ships (cutting launch costs by 90%). Tesla Model S, Model X, and 'Production Hell' of Model 3. Tesla becomes most valuable carmaker. Starlink and space internet monopoly.

segments.title: The Trillionaire Payoff & Callback to the $1
segments.summary: Returning to 2026: The math of compound high-risk bets. Callback to the opening hook ($1 closer to 2nd richest than 2nd richest to Elon). Closing moral: What separates an insane gamble from visionary genius is just one launch that doesn't blow up.
